name: Push-up Counter
description: Put your phone on the floor and touch it with your nose on every push-up. Daily goal, a 30-day calendar and records.
prompt: A push-up counter where you touch the screen with your nose on each rep, with beeps and vibration, counting out loud every ten, sets saved per day, an adjustable daily goal, a 30-day heat calendar, a streak and records for best set, best day and total.
author: gonzaroman
